ex.en: It can be dangerous for young people to ride motorcycles.
ex.zh: 年輕人騎機車可能很危險。

ex.en: Why don't you have your motorcycle fixed up?
ex.zh: 你為什麼不把機車拿去修？

ex.en: I don't know how much this motorcycle is.
ex.zh: 我不知道這台機車多少錢。

motorcycle.en: a two-wheeled vehicle with an engine that you ride

ex.en: The bonus really boosted staff morale.
ex.zh: 這筆獎金大大提振了員工士氣。

ex.en: Team morale is low after the layoffs.
ex.zh: 裁員之後，團隊士氣很低落。

morale.en: the level of confidence and good feeling among a group of people

ex.en: Do not make any modifications before you get confirmations.
ex.zh: 在得到確認之前，不要做任何修改。

ex.en: I made a few modifications.
ex.zh: 我做了一些修改。

ex.en: You need to consider the consequences before making any modifications to existing code.
ex.zh: 修改現有程式碼之前，你需要考慮後果。

modification.en: a small change made to improve something

ex.en: Try restarting the modem if the internet is slow.
ex.zh: 網路很慢的話，試著重新啟動數據機。

ex.en: The technician came to install a new modem.
ex.zh: 技術人員來安裝新的數據機。

modem.en: a device that connects a computer to the internet through a phone or cable line

ex.en: I got a lot of mosquito bites.
ex.zh: 我被蚊子叮了好多包。

ex.en: I just got bitten by a mosquito.
ex.zh: 我剛剛被蚊子叮了。

ex.en: The good thing about winter is that there are no mosquitos.
ex.zh: 冬天的好處是沒有蚊子。

mosquito.en: a small flying insect that bites people and animals and sucks blood

ex.en: The lawn mower is in the garage.
ex.zh: 割草機在車庫裡。

ex.en: Our mower broke, so we borrowed one from the neighbor.
ex.zh: 我們的割草機壞了，所以跟鄰居借了一台。

mower.en: a machine used for cutting grass

ex.en: The central bank changed its monetary policy.
ex.zh: 央行調整了貨幣政策。

ex.en: The prize has no monetary value.
ex.zh: 這個獎品沒有金錢價值。

ex.en: After winning the Nobel prize, she remained as modest as ever.
ex.zh: 她得到諾貝爾獎後，依然像以前一樣謙虛。

ex.en: You are much too modest.
ex.zh: 你太謙虛了。

ex.en: Try to be a bit more modest.
ex.zh: 試著謙虛一點。

modest.en: not talking proudly about your own abilities or success

ex.en: It was a modest outcome.
ex.zh: 結果並不突出。

ex.en: The result was modest.
ex.zh: 成果有限。

ex.en: Sales showed a modest increase this quarter.
ex.zh: 這一季銷售額小幅成長。

ex.en: What was his motive for doing it?
ex.zh: 他這麼做的動機是什麼？

ex.en: The police are still looking for a motive.
ex.zh: 警方仍在找尋動機。

ex.en: I don't doubt her motives for helping us.
ex.zh: 我不懷疑她幫助我們的動機。

motive.en: the reason why someone does something

ex.en: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
ex.zh: 一個水分子是由兩個氫原子和一個氧原子組成的。

ex.en: This drug works by blocking a specific molecule.
ex.zh: 這種藥是藉由阻斷某種特定分子來發揮作用。

molecule.en: the smallest unit of a substance, made of two or more atoms

ex.en: The campaign is gaining momentum.
ex.zh: 這波活動聲勢越來越大。

ex.en: We need to keep up the momentum after this success.
ex.zh: 成功之後，我們要保持這股氣勢。

ex.en: The project lost momentum after the manager left.
ex.zh: 經理離職後，這個專案就失去了動力。

momentum.en: the force that keeps something moving or developing faster

ex.en: Education can increase social mobility.
ex.zh: 教育能提高社會流動性。

ex.en: Laptops give workers greater mobility.
ex.zh: 筆電讓員工能更自由地移動辦公。

mobility.en: the ability to move or travel easily

ex.en: He goes to the mosque five times a day.
ex.zh: 他每天去清真寺五次。

ex.en: This is a house and that is a mosque.
ex.zh: 這是一棟房子，那是一座清真寺。

mosque.en: a building where Muslims go to pray

ex.en: There's mold growing on the bathroom wall.
ex.zh: 浴室牆上長了黴。

ex.en: Throw away the bread if it has mold on it.
ex.zh: 麵包發黴的話就丟掉。

mold.en: a green or black growth that forms on old food or on damp walls

ex.en: The chocolate is poured into a heart-shaped mold.
ex.zh: 巧克力被倒進心形的模具裡。

ex.en: He doesn't fit the mold of a typical manager.
ex.zh: 他不是典型的那種經理。

mold.en: a hollow container that gives a shape to a liquid as it hardens

ex.en: Parents help mold their children's character.
ex.zh: 父母幫助塑造孩子的性格。

ex.en: The clay can be molded into any shape.
ex.zh: 黏土可以捏成任何形狀。

mold.en: to shape something, or to influence how something develops

ex.en: The company acted like a monopolist in the local market.
ex.zh: 這家公司在當地市場的行為就像壟斷者。

ex.en: A monopolist can raise prices without losing customers.
ex.zh: 壟斷者可以漲價而不流失顧客。

monopolist.en: a person or company that is the only one selling a product or service

ex.en: My driving instructor says I should be more patient.
ex.zh: 我的駕訓教練說我應該更有耐心一點。

ex.en: You should pay more attention to what he says.
ex.zh: 你應該多注意他說的話。

more.en: used before an adjective or adverb to make it stronger in comparison

ex.en: I have no more time to talk with you.
ex.zh: 我沒時間再跟你說話了。

ex.en: We need more time to finish the project.
ex.zh: 我們需要更多時間完成這個專案。

ex.en: Would you like some more coffee?
ex.zh: 你還要再來點咖啡嗎？

more.en: a greater amount or number of something, or an extra amount

ex.en: Can you tell me more about the job?
ex.zh: 可以多告訴我一些這份工作的事嗎？

ex.en: I'd like to learn more.
ex.zh: 我想多了解一些。

more.en: a greater amount or extra information

ex.en: The project is more or less finished.
ex.zh: 這個專案差不多完成了。

ex.en: It costs 100 dollars, more or less.
ex.zh: 大約要一百元。

ex.en: Paris is the most beautiful city in the world.
ex.zh: 巴黎是世界上最美麗的城市。

ex.en: Nancy is the most beautiful of the four girls.
ex.zh: 四個女孩中，南希最漂亮。

most.en: used before an adjective or adverb to show the highest degree

ex.en: Most Swiss people can speak three or four languages.
ex.zh: 大多數瑞士人會說三、四種語言。

ex.en: Most stores close at ten.
ex.zh: 大多數商店十點關門。

most.en: nearly all of the people or things

ex.en: I spent most of the day in meetings.
ex.zh: 我一天大部分時間都在開會。

ex.en: Most of the staff agreed with the plan.
ex.zh: 大部分員工都同意這個計畫。

ex.en: The trip will take two hours at most.
ex.zh: 這趟路程最多兩小時。

ex.en: We can invite ten people at most.
ex.zh: 我們最多可以邀請十個人。

most.en: not more than a certain number or amount

ex.en: The bag was too heavy for me to move.
ex.zh: 那個袋子太重，我搬不動。

ex.en: Tom can't move this bookcase without a little help.
ex.zh: 沒人幫忙的話，湯姆搬不動這個書櫃。

move.en: to change position or put something in a different place

ex.en: More and more people are moving to urban areas.
ex.zh: 越來越多人搬到都市地區。

ex.en: We moved to Taichung last year.
ex.zh: 我們去年搬到台中。

move.en: to leave your home and live in a different place

ex.en: I was moved by her love for other people.
ex.zh: 她對別人的愛讓我很感動。

ex.en: The movie moved everyone to tears.
ex.zh: 這部電影讓每個人都感動落淚。

move.en: to make someone feel strong emotion such as sadness or sympathy

ex.en: The meeting has been moved to Friday.
ex.zh: 會議已改到星期五。

ex.en: Can we move the call to 3 p.m.?
ex.zh: 我們可以把電話會議改到下午三點嗎？

move.en: to change the time or date of an event

ex.en: That was a smart move.
ex.zh: 那是很聰明的一步。

ex.en: Hiring her was a good move.
ex.zh: 僱用她是正確的決定。

move.en: an action taken to achieve something

ex.en: Luckily he had enough money to pay the bill.
ex.zh: 幸好他有足夠的錢付帳。

ex.en: If I had enough money, I could go abroad.
ex.zh: 如果我有足夠的錢，就能出國了。

ex.en: The company spends a lot of money on advertising.
ex.zh: 那家公司在廣告上花了很多錢。

money.en: coins and notes that you use to buy things

ex.en: He makes money by teaching English.
ex.zh: 他靠教英文賺錢。

ex.en: It's hard to make money in this business.
ex.zh: 這一行很難賺錢。

money.en: to earn or get an amount of cash

ex.en: Two months have passed since he left for France.
ex.zh: 他去法國已經兩個月了。

ex.en: I lived for more than a month in Nagoya.
ex.zh: 我在名古屋住了一個多月。

ex.en: How often do you wash your car a month?
ex.zh: 你一個月洗幾次車？

month.en: one of the twelve periods that a year is divided into

ex.en: I asked Mother to wake me up at four.
ex.zh: 我請媽媽四點叫我起床。

ex.en: I cannot cook as well as my mother does.
ex.zh: 我的廚藝比不上我媽。

ex.en: Life is not easy for working mothers.
ex.zh: 對職業婦女來說，生活並不容易。

ex.en: Please wait a moment.
ex.zh: 請稍等一下。

ex.en: Could I talk to you for a moment?
ex.zh: 我可以跟你談一下嗎？

moment.en: a very short period of time

ex.en: We had wonderful moments together.
ex.zh: 我們一起度過了美好的時光。

ex.en: It was the happiest moment of my life.
ex.zh: 那是我人生中最快樂的時刻。

moment.en: a particular point or period of time

ex.en: I have a lot of problems at the moment.
ex.zh: 我目前有很多問題。

ex.en: He's not available at the moment.
ex.zh: 他現在不方便接電話。

ex.en: The moment she saw me, she burst out crying.
ex.zh: 她一看到我就哭了出來。

ex.en: The moment she was alone, she opened the letter.
ex.zh: 她一獨處，就打開了那封信。

moment.en: used to say that something happens immediately after something else

ex.en: I feed my cat every morning and every evening.
ex.zh: 我每天早上和晚上都會餵貓。

ex.en: When I got up this morning, it was raining.
ex.zh: 我今天早上起床時正在下雨。

ex.en: She gets up late on Sunday mornings.
ex.zh: 她星期天早上都很晚起床。

morning.en: the early part of the day, from sunrise until noon

ex.en: Each movement of the dancer was perfect.
ex.zh: 那位舞者的每個動作都很完美。

ex.en: Avoid sudden movements around the rabbit, they can startle them.
ex.zh: 在兔子旁邊避免突然的動作，以免嚇到牠們。

movement.en: an act of changing the position of the body or a part of it

ex.en: Your son took part in the student movement, I hear.
ex.zh: 聽說你兒子參加了學生運動。

ex.en: The environmental movement is growing fast.
ex.zh: 環保運動發展得很快。

movement.en: a group of people working together to achieve a social or political aim

ex.en: The police were suspicious of his movements.
ex.zh: 警方對他的行蹤起疑。

ex.en: The movement of goods across borders is easier now.
ex.zh: 現在貨物跨境流動更容易了。

movement.en: the act of going from one place to another, or where a person goes

ex.en: Modern technology has made our lives more comfortable.
ex.zh: 現代科技讓我們的生活更舒適。

ex.en: I like classical music more than modern music.
ex.zh: 比起現代音樂，我更喜歡古典音樂。

ex.en: Modern ships only need a small crew.
ex.zh: 現代船隻只需要少數船員。

modern.en: relating to the present time or recent times

ex.en: The living room furniture was modern in style.
ex.zh: 客廳的家具是現代風格。

ex.en: The office has a very modern design.
ex.zh: 這間辦公室的設計很新潮。

modern.en: new in style or design, and not old-fashioned

ex.en: I mostly have fruit for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我早餐大多吃水果。

ex.en: Tom mostly kept to himself.
ex.zh: 湯姆大多獨來獨往。

ex.en: The audience was mostly students.
ex.zh: 觀眾大多是學生。

mostly.en: in nearly all cases, or for the larger part

ex.en: I'll monitor your progress from my computer.
ex.zh: 我會用我的電腦追蹤你的進度。

ex.en: We monitor the system 24 hours a day.
ex.zh: 我們全天候監控系統。

monitor.en: to watch and check something carefully over a period of time

ex.en: I use two monitors at work.
ex.zh: 我上班時用兩台螢幕。

ex.en: The nurse checked the heart monitor.
ex.zh: 護理師檢查了心臟監測器。

monitor.en: a screen that shows pictures or information, or a device that checks something

ex.en: Whilst at university, Xiaowang held the post of class monitor.
ex.zh: 小王讀大學時當過班長。

ex.en: She was chosen as class monitor.
ex.zh: 她被選為班長。

monitor.en: a student chosen to help the teacher and keep order in a class

ex.en: The house looked good; moreover, the price was right.
ex.zh: 這間房子看起來不錯，而且價格也合理。

ex.en: It's a cat, and moreover an orange one.
ex.zh: 這是一隻貓，而且是隻橘貓。

ex.en: The hotel is cheap; moreover, it's close to the station.
ex.zh: 這家飯店很便宜，而且離車站很近。

moreover.en: used to add another fact that supports what was said before

ex.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
ex.zh: 咳嗽、打噴嚏或打哈欠時要遮住嘴巴。

ex.en: We eat with our mouths.
ex.zh: 我們用嘴巴吃東西。

mouth.en: the opening in the face used for eating and speaking

ex.en: The town lies at the mouth of the river.
ex.zh: 這座小鎮位於河口。

ex.en: Bats flew out of the mouth of the cave.
ex.zh: 蝙蝠從洞口飛了出來。

mouth.en: the place where a river flows into the sea, or the entrance to a cave

mouth.zh: live from hand to mouth：勉強餬口

ex.en: We lived from hand to mouth in those days.
ex.zh: 那段日子我們過得很拮据，勉強餬口。

ex.en: Many young workers live from hand to mouth.
ex.zh: 許多年輕上班族過著勉強餬口的生活。

mouth.en: to have only just enough money to live on

ex.en: This school sets high moral standards for pupils.
ex.zh: 這所學校對學生的道德標準要求很高。

ex.en: Doctors have a moral duty to help patients.
ex.zh: 醫生在道德上有義務幫助病人。

moral.en: relating to what is right and wrong in behavior

ex.en: Public morals are not respected anymore in this town.
ex.zh: 在這座城鎮，公共道德已不再受到重視。

ex.en: He is a man of strong morals.
ex.zh: 他是個品德高尚的人。

moral.en: standards of behavior that people think are right and good

ex.en: The moral of the story is that honesty pays.
ex.zh: 這個故事的寓意是誠實終有好報。

ex.en: What's the moral of this fable?
ex.zh: 這則寓言的寓意是什麼？

moral.en: the lesson that a story or event teaches

moral.zh: 精神上的（moral support 精神支持）

ex.en: Thanks for your moral support.
ex.zh: 謝謝你在精神上的支持。

ex.en: My friends came along for moral support.
ex.zh: 朋友們陪我一起去，給我打氣。

moral.en: giving help through encouragement and kindness, not with money or action

ex.en: Most young people have a mobile phone.
ex.zh: 大部分年輕人都有手機。

ex.en: I need to charge my mobile phone.
ex.zh: 我需要幫手機充電。

ex.en: Our app works on both computers and mobile devices.
ex.zh: 我們的應用程式在電腦和行動裝置上都能使用。

mobile.en: able to be moved easily from place to place

ex.en: I need to charge my mobile.
ex.zh: 我需要幫手機充電。

ex.en: Call me on my mobile if you get lost.
ex.zh: 如果你迷路了，就打我手機。

mobile.en: a small phone that you can carry and use anywhere

ex.en: They showed the scene in slow motion.
ex.zh: 他們用慢動作播放那一幕。

ex.en: They looked relieved only when it was in motion.
ex.zh: 直到它開始運轉，他們才鬆了一口氣。

motion.en: the act or process of moving

ex.en: I motioned for her to sit down.
ex.zh: 我示意她坐下。

ex.en: My father motioned for me to leave the meeting room.
ex.zh: 我父親示意我離開會議室。

motion.en: to make a movement of the hand or head to tell someone something

ex.en: The motion was passed by a vote of 10 to 2.
ex.zh: 這項動議以十比二的票數通過。

ex.en: I'd like to make a motion to end the meeting.
ex.zh: 我提議結束會議。

motion.en: a formal suggestion that is discussed and voted on at a meeting

ex.en: We got rid of the mice in their house.
ex.zh: 我們幫他們清除了家裡的老鼠。

ex.en: Walking along the fence he noticed a mouse.
ex.zh: 他沿著籬笆走時看到一隻老鼠。

ex.en: When the cat is away, the mice will play.
ex.zh: 貓不在，老鼠就作怪。

mouse.en: a small furry animal with a long tail

ex.en: Click the left mouse button.
ex.zh: 按下滑鼠左鍵。

ex.en: My mouse stopped working.
ex.zh: 我的滑鼠壞了。

mouse.en: a small device you move by hand to control a computer screen

ex.en: I hope Tom is in a good mood tomorrow.
ex.zh: 希望湯姆明天心情好。

ex.en: I'm not in a mood to go out.
ex.zh: 我沒心情出門。

ex.en: She was not in the mood for lunch.
ex.zh: 她沒心情吃午餐。

mood.en: the way you feel at a particular time

ex.en: The mood in the office was tense after the news.
ex.zh: 消息傳出後，辦公室的氣氛很緊繃。

ex.en: Music can change the mood of a party.
ex.zh: 音樂可以改變派對的氣氛。

mood.en: the feeling that a place or situation gives

ex.en: Dad! Mom! I have some great news for you!
ex.zh: 爸！媽！我有好消息要告訴你們！

ex.en: My mom forgot to add salt to the salad.
ex.zh: 我媽忘了在沙拉裡加鹽。

ex.en: My mom calls me every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我媽每個星期天都會打電話給我。

mom.en: a word for mother, used mainly in American English

ex.en: This program cannot be run in DOS mode.
ex.zh: 這個程式無法在 DOS 模式下執行。

ex.en: Please switch your phone to silent mode.
ex.zh: 請把手機切換到靜音模式。

mode.en: one of the ways a machine or program can work

ex.en: Trains are a popular mode of transport in Japan.
ex.zh: 火車在日本是很受歡迎的交通方式。

ex.en: Cycling is a cheap and healthy mode of transport.
ex.zh: 騎腳踏車是便宜又健康的交通方式。

mode.en: a particular way of doing something

ex.en: The jeweler mounted a big pearl in the brooch.
ex.zh: 珠寶師傅把一顆大珍珠鑲在胸針上。

ex.en: The TV is mounted on the wall.
ex.zh: 電視被安裝在牆上。

mount.en: to fix something firmly in place on a surface or in a frame

ex.en: Costs continued to mount during the project.
ex.zh: 專案進行期間成本持續增加。

ex.en: Pressure on the team is mounting.
ex.zh: 團隊的壓力越來越大。

mount.en: to slowly grow larger in amount or level

ex.en: The museum is mounting a new exhibition.
ex.zh: 博物館正在籌辦一場新展覽。

ex.en: The company mounted a big advertising campaign.
ex.zh: 公司發起了一場大型廣告活動。

mount.en: to organize and begin an event or a plan

ex.en: He climbed Mount Fuji four times.
ex.zh: 他爬過富士山四次。

ex.en: In clear weather one can see Mount Fuji from here.
ex.zh: 天氣晴朗時，從這裡可以看到富士山。

ex.en: How high is Mount Everest?
ex.zh: 聖母峰有多高？

mount.en: a word used before the name of a mountain

ex.en: Moderate exercise will refresh both mind and body.
ex.zh: 適度的運動能讓身心煥然一新。

ex.en: Moderate exercise is necessary for good health.
ex.zh: 適度運動對健康是必要的。

ex.en: The hotel offers rooms at moderate prices.
ex.zh: 這家飯店的房價適中。

moderate.en: not too much and not too little

ex.en: Amy will moderate the panel discussion.
ex.zh: Amy 會主持這場座談。

ex.en: Who is moderating tonight's debate?
ex.zh: 今晚的辯論由誰主持？

moderate.en: to lead a discussion and make sure it goes well

ex.en: Is there a problem with the motor?
ex.zh: 是馬達出了問題嗎？

ex.en: The fan has a small electric motor.
ex.zh: 這台電扇有一個小型電動馬達。

motor.en: a machine that uses power to make something move

ex.en: The number of motor vehicles in the city has increased.
ex.zh: 城裡的機動車輛數量增加了。

ex.en: He works in the motor industry.
ex.zh: 他在汽車業工作。

motor.en: driven by an engine, or relating to cars

ex.en: It's useless, I'm not motivated today for some reason.
ex.zh: 沒辦法，今天不知道為什麼提不起勁。

ex.en: A good manager knows how to motivate the team.
ex.zh: 好的主管懂得如何激勵團隊。

ex.en: What motivated you to learn English?
ex.zh: 是什麼促使你學英文？

motivate.en: to give someone a reason or the energy to do something

ex.en: We want to modify the regulations of our school.
ex.zh: 我們想修改學校的規章。

ex.en: We modified the design based on customer feedback.
ex.zh: 我們根據顧客意見修改了設計。

ex.en: You can modify your order before it ships.
ex.zh: 出貨前您可以修改訂單。

modify.en: to change something a little to improve it

ex.en: Adjectives modify nouns.
ex.zh: 形容詞修飾名詞。

ex.en: Adverbs often modify verbs.
ex.zh: 副詞常用來修飾動詞。

modify.en: to give more information about another word in a sentence

ex.en: We cannot see the other side of the moon.
ex.zh: 我們看不到月球的另一面。

ex.en: An eclipse of the moon is a rare phenomenon.
ex.zh: 月食是一種罕見的現象。

ex.en: The moon is very bright tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚的月亮很亮。

moon.en: the large round object that shines in the sky at night

ex.en: There may be life on the moons of Jupiter.
ex.zh: 木星的衛星上可能有生命。

ex.en: My telescope can see Jupiter and its six moons.
ex.zh: 我的望遠鏡可以看到木星和它的六顆衛星。

moon.en: a natural object that travels around a planet

ex.en: I've lost my motivation to study.
ex.zh: 我失去了讀書的動力。

ex.en: Money isn't my only motivation for working.
ex.zh: 錢不是我工作的唯一動機。

ex.en: The coach is good at giving the team motivation.
ex.zh: 教練很會激勵球隊。

motivation.en: the reason or energy that makes you want to do something

ex.en: How much is the monthly fee of this swimming school?
ex.zh: 這間游泳學校每個月的學費是多少？

ex.en: How much is your monthly gas bill?
ex.zh: 你每個月的瓦斯費是多少？

ex.en: Attached is my monthly report.
ex.zh: 附上我的月報。

monthly.en: happening or paid once in each of the year's twelve parts

ex.en: Employees are paid monthly.
ex.zh: 員工按月領薪。

ex.en: The magazine is published monthly.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌每月出刊。

monthly.en: once in each of the year's twelve parts

ex.en: The course is divided into six modules.
ex.zh: 這門課分成六個單元。

ex.en: Each module takes about two weeks to complete.
ex.zh: 每個單元大約要兩週完成。

module.en: one of the separate parts that a course is divided into

ex.en: You need to install an extra module for this feature.
ex.zh: 你要安裝額外的模組才能使用這個功能。

ex.en: The camera module was replaced.
ex.zh: 相機模組換新了。

module.en: a separate part that can be added to a computer system

ex.en: The doctor checked the mole on my arm.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查了我手臂上的痣。

ex.en: I have a small mole on my cheek.
ex.zh: 我臉頰上有一顆小痣。

mole.en: a small dark spot on the skin

ex.en: A mole dug holes all over our garden.
ex.zh: 一隻鼴鼠把我們的花園挖得到處是洞。

ex.en: Moles live underground and can barely see.
ex.zh: 鼴鼠住在地底下，幾乎看不見東西。

mole.en: a small furry animal that lives underground and digs tunnels

ex.en: The company suspected a mole was leaking its secrets.
ex.zh: 公司懷疑有內奸在洩漏機密。

ex.en: The police finally found the mole in their department.
ex.zh: 警方終於揪出了部門裡的內奸。

mole.en: a person who secretly gives information about their own group to others

ex.en: She is studying molecular biology at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學念分子生物學。

ex.en: Scientists examined the molecular structure of the new drug.
ex.zh: 科學家研究了這種新藥的分子結構。

molecular.en: relating to the very small groups of atoms that make up a substance

ex.en: He was scared when the monkey jumped at him.
ex.zh: 猴子朝他撲過來時，他嚇了一跳。

ex.en: It is easy for a monkey to climb a tree.
ex.zh: 爬樹對猴子來說很容易。

ex.en: Monkeys can learn a lot of tricks.
ex.zh: 猴子能學會很多把戲。

monkey.en: an animal with a long tail that climbs trees and uses its hands

ex.en: Stop monkeying around and finish your homework.
ex.zh: 別再胡鬧了，快把功課寫完。

ex.en: The kids were monkeying around in the classroom.
ex.zh: 孩子們在教室裡胡鬧。

monkey.en: to behave in a silly way or waste time

ex.en: Many people question the morality of the decision.
ex.zh: 很多人質疑這個決定是否合乎道德。

ex.en: The novel explores themes of love and morality.
ex.zh: 這部小說探討愛與道德的主題。

morality.en: beliefs about what is right and wrong

ex.en: The researchers compared the morphological features of the two species.
ex.zh: 研究人員比較了這兩個物種的形態特徵。

ex.en: Morphological analysis studies how words are formed.
ex.zh: 詞法分析研究單字是如何構成的。

morphological.en: relating to the shape and structure of living things or words

ex.en: The plant's morphology changes in dry climates.
ex.zh: 這種植物的形態在乾燥氣候中會改變。

ex.en: She wrote her thesis on the morphology of insects.
ex.zh: 她的論文主題是昆蟲的形態學。

morphology.en: the study of the shape and structure of plants and animals

ex.en: Morphology is the study of how words are built.
ex.zh: 構詞學是研究單字如何構成的學問。

ex.en: Chinese morphology is quite different from English.
ex.zh: 中文的構詞方式和英文很不一樣。

morphology.en: the study of the parts that words are made of

ex.en: Infant mortality has fallen sharply in recent decades.
ex.zh: 近幾十年來，嬰兒死亡率大幅下降。

ex.en: The disease has a high mortality rate.
ex.zh: 這種疾病的死亡率很高。

mortality.en: the number of deaths in a group of people over a period of time

ex.en: The accident made him think about his own mortality.
ex.zh: 這場意外讓他思考起自己終將一死。

ex.en: Getting older reminds us of our mortality.
ex.zh: 年紀漸長讓我們意識到生命有限。

mortality.en: the fact that all people must die one day

ex.en: The dress has a flower motif.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝有花朵圖案。

ex.en: The wallpaper features a simple leaf motif.
ex.zh: 這款壁紙以簡單的葉子圖案為特色。

motif.en: a pattern or picture that is repeated as a decoration

motif.zh: （作品中反覆出現的）主題、主旨

ex.en: Travel is a recurring motif in her novels.
ex.zh: 旅行是她小說中反覆出現的主題。

ex.en: Water is a key motif in the film.
ex.zh: 水是這部電影的重要意象。

motif.en: an idea that appears again and again in a piece of art or writing

ex.en: This is the worst movie I have ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我看過的最差勁的電影了。

ex.en: My father took me to a movie last night.
ex.zh: 我爸爸昨晚帶我去看電影。

ex.en: She used to go to the movies on Sundays.
ex.zh: 她以前星期天都會去看電影。

movie.en: a story told with moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema

ex.en: At last, they reached the top of the mountain.
ex.zh: 他們終於到達了山頂。

ex.en: The mountain is not as high as Mt. Fuji.
ex.zh: 這座山沒有富士山高。

ex.en: My younger brother really likes to take photos of mountains.
ex.zh: 我弟弟很喜歡拍山的照片。

mountain.en: a very high area of land that rises above the ground around it

ex.en: I have a mountain of work to do today.
ex.zh: 我今天有一大堆工作要做。

ex.en: There's a mountain of laundry on the bed.
ex.zh: 床上堆了一大堆要洗的衣服。

mountain.en: a very large amount of something

ex.en: When you're done sweeping, I'll mop.
ex.zh: 你掃完地之後，我來拖地。

ex.en: Tom mopped the floor.
ex.zh: 湯姆拖了地。

mop.en: to clean a floor with a wet cleaning tool

ex.en: The mop is in the closet next to the bathroom.
ex.zh: 拖把在浴室旁邊的櫃子裡。

ex.en: Wring out the mop before you use it.
ex.zh: 用之前先把拖把擰乾。

mop.en: a tool with a long handle and soft threads, used to clean floors

ex.en: He mocks me.
ex.zh: 他嘲笑我。

ex.en: Some students mocked him for his accent.
ex.zh: 有些學生嘲笑他的口音。

mock.en: to laugh at someone in an unkind way

ex.en: The future pilot is trained in a mock cockpit.
ex.zh: 未來飛行員將在模擬操作室中訓練。

ex.en: Students took a mock exam before the real test.
ex.zh: 學生們在正式考試前先參加了模擬考。

mock.en: not real, but made to look or work like the real thing

ex.en: Winds from the sea are moist.
ex.zh: 從海洋吹來的風感覺溼漉漉的。

ex.en: Keep the soil moist but not wet.
ex.zh: 讓土壤保持濕潤但不要積水。

ex.en: The cake was soft and moist.
ex.zh: 這個蛋糕又軟又濕潤。

ex.en: The injured man moaned in pain.
ex.zh: 受傷的男子痛苦地呻吟。

ex.en: Stop moaning about the weather and enjoy the trip.
ex.zh: 別再抱怨天氣，好好享受旅程吧。

moan.en: to make a long low sound because of pain, or to complain

ex.en: We heard a low moan from the next room.
ex.zh: 我們聽見隔壁房間傳來低低的呻吟聲。

ex.en: The wind made a long moan through the trees.
ex.zh: 風在樹林間發出長長的嗚咽聲。

moan.en: a long low sound made because of pain or sadness

ex.en: In the story, a monstrous creature lived under the bridge.
ex.zh: 故事裡，橋底下住著一隻怪物般的可怕生物。

ex.en: The dictator was responsible for monstrous crimes.
ex.zh: 那名獨裁者犯下了駭人聽聞的罪行。

ex.en: She broke the monotony of office work by taking up painting.
ex.zh: 她靠學畫畫來打破辦公室工作的單調。

ex.en: The monotony of the long drive made him sleepy.
ex.zh: 長途駕駛的單調讓他昏昏欲睡。

monotony.en: the boring quality of something that never changes

ex.en: The widow mourned her husband for a long time.
ex.zh: 寡婦為她的丈夫哀悼了很久。

ex.en: The widow mourned for her husband for a long time.
ex.zh: 寡婦為她的丈夫哀悼了很久。

ex.en: The whole country mourned the death of the famous singer.
ex.zh: 全國都在哀悼那位知名歌手的逝世。

mourn.en: to feel and show great sadness because someone has died

ex.en: Our company motto is "Customers come first."
ex.zh: 我們公司的座右銘是「顧客至上」。

ex.en: His motto in life is to never give up.
ex.zh: 他的人生座右銘是永不放棄。

motto.en: a short phrase that expresses the rules or goals of a person or group

ex.en: This cream helps your skin keep its moisture.
ex.zh: 這款乳霜能幫助肌膚保濕。

ex.en: Moisture in the walls can cause mold and breathing problems.
ex.zh: 牆壁裡的濕氣可能導致發霉和呼吸道問題。

moisture.en: small drops of water in the air or on a surface

ex.en: Even when one is being praised, modesty is important.
ex.zh: 即使在受到表揚的時候，謙虛也是很重要的。

ex.en: His modesty is worth respecting.
ex.zh: 他的謙遜值得尊敬。

ex.en: Despite her success, she spoke about her work with great modesty.
ex.zh: 儘管很成功，她談起自己的工作時仍非常謙虛。

modesty.en: the quality of not talking proudly about yourself

ex.en: An angry mob gathered outside the city hall.
ex.zh: 一群憤怒的民眾聚集在市政府外面。

ex.en: The police tried to stop the mob from breaking into the store.
ex.zh: 警察試圖阻止暴民闖進商店。

mob.en: a large crowd that is angry and difficult to control

ex.en: Fans mobbed the singer as soon as she left the airport.
ex.zh: 歌手一走出機場，粉絲就蜂擁而上把她團團圍住。

ex.en: The famous actor was mobbed by reporters outside the theater.
ex.zh: 那位知名演員在戲院外被記者團團包圍。

mob.en: to crowd around someone in a noisy and excited way

ex.en: She found motherhood both tiring and deeply rewarding.
ex.zh: 她覺得當媽媽既辛苦又很有成就感。

ex.en: Many women return to work after a year of motherhood.
ex.zh: 很多女性在當了一年全職媽媽後重返職場。

motherhood.en: the state of being a mother

ex.en: He was opposed to monopolies.
ex.zh: 他反對壟斷。

ex.en: The company has a monopoly on the city's water supply.
ex.zh: 這家公司壟斷了全市的供水。

monopoly.en: complete control of a business or product by one company

ex.en: Monopoly is a popular game for families to play.
ex.zh: 大富翁是很受家庭歡迎的遊戲。

ex.en: We played Monopoly all night.
ex.zh: 我們玩了一整晚的大富翁。

monopoly.en: the name of a board game in which players buy and sell property

ex.en: We took out a 30-year mortgage to buy our home.
ex.zh: 我們申請了三十年的房貸買房子。

ex.en: Most of my salary goes to the mortgage.
ex.zh: 我大部分的薪水都拿去付房貸。

mortgage.en: money borrowed from a bank to buy a house, paid back over many years

ex.en: He compared his car to the new model.
ex.zh: 他拿自己的車和新款比較。

ex.en: This is the latest model of the phone.
ex.zh: 這是這支手機的最新型號。

model.en: a particular type or design of a product

ex.en: Mike has been making a model plane since breakfast.
ex.zh: 邁克從早餐後就一直在做模型飛機。

ex.en: All models are wrong, but some are useful.
ex.zh: 所有的模型都是錯的，但有些是有用的。

model.en: a small copy of something, made to show how it looks

ex.en: She is said to have been a model.
ex.zh: 據說她以前當過模特兒。

ex.en: The model walked down the runway.
ex.zh: 模特兒走上伸展台。

model.en: a person whose job is to wear clothes or pose for pictures

ex.en: The moderator invited questions from the audience.
ex.zh: 主持人邀請觀眾提問。

ex.en: Our moderator kept the panel discussion on schedule.
ex.zh: 我們的主持人讓座談會按時進行。

moderator.en: a person who leads a discussion and keeps it fair

modular.zh: 模組化的；由標準組件構成的

ex.en: The modular system is easy to expand.
ex.zh: 這套模組化系統很容易擴充。

ex.en: We chose modular furniture for the new office.
ex.zh: 我們為新辦公室選用了模組化家具。

modular.en: made of separate parts that can be joined together in different ways

ex.en: Motorists should avoid the tunnel while crews repair the lights.
ex.zh: 施工人員維修照明期間，駕駛人應避開該隧道。

ex.en: The sign warns motorists that the road narrows ahead.
ex.zh: 這個標誌提醒駕駛人前方道路會縮窄。

motorist.en: a person who drives a car

ex.en: A monument was built to honor the soldiers.
ex.zh: 人們建了一座紀念碑來紀念那些士兵。

ex.en: The old temple is a national monument.
ex.zh: 那座古廟是國定古蹟。

monument.en: a building or statue that reminds people of a person or an event

ex.en: The little boy thought there was a monster under his bed.
ex.zh: 小男孩以為床底下有怪物。

ex.en: The movie is about a giant monster attacking a city.
ex.zh: 這部電影是關於巨大怪物攻擊城市的故事。

ex.en: My dog is a monster when it sees a squirrel.
ex.zh: 我的狗一看到松鼠就變得很瘋狂。

ex.en: Regular monitoring of blood pressure is important.
ex.zh: 定期監測血壓很重要。

ex.en: The monitoring of air quality starts next month.
ex.zh: 空氣品質監測將從下個月開始。

ex.en: We drove on the motorway for two hours.
ex.zh: 我們在高速公路上開了兩個小時。

ex.en: The motorway was closed because of heavy fog.
ex.zh: 因為大霧，高速公路封閉了。

ex.en: The monk walked quietly through the temple garden.
ex.zh: 那位僧人安靜地走過寺廟的庭院。

ex.en: Many monks wake up before sunrise to pray.
ex.zh: 許多僧侶在日出前就起床祈禱。

ex.en: I have a dentist appointment on Monday morning.
ex.zh: 我星期一早上要去看牙醫。

ex.en: Most people don't like going back to work on Monday.
ex.zh: 大多數人都不喜歡星期一回去上班。

ex.en: The shop is closed every Monday for cleaning.
ex.zh: 這家店每個星期一都休息打掃。

ex.en: Moscow is the capital city of Russia.
ex.zh: 莫斯科是俄羅斯的首都。

ex.en: It gets very cold in Moscow during the winter.
ex.zh: 莫斯科的冬天非常寒冷。

ex.en: Morgan is both a surname and a first name.
ex.zh: 摩根既是姓氏，也可以當作名字。

ex.en: The name Morgan has Welsh origins.
ex.zh: 摩根這個名字源自威爾斯。

ex.en: We walked across the open moor on a windy afternoon.
ex.zh: 一個颳風的下午，我們走過空曠的荒野。

ex.en: Sheep were grazing on the moor.
ex.zh: 羊群在荒野上吃草。

ex.en: They moored the boat to a post at the dock.
ex.zh: 他們把船繫在碼頭的柱子上。

ex.en: We moored near the village for the night.
ex.zh: 我們把船停泊在村莊附近過夜。

ex.en: The children climbed to the top of the grassy mound.
ex.zh: 孩子們爬上了長滿草的小土丘。

ex.en: A mound of dirt was left beside the hole.
ex.zh: 洞旁邊留下了一堆泥土。

ex.en: There was a mound of laundry waiting on the bed.
ex.zh: 床上堆了一大堆待洗的衣服。

ex.en: He left a mound of dishes in the sink.
ex.zh: 他在水槽裡留了一大堆碗盤。

ex.en: The farmers mounded the soil around the young plants.
ex.zh: 農夫把土堆在幼苗周圍。

ex.en: Snow mounded up against the garage door overnight.
ex.zh: 雪一夜之間在車庫門邊堆成了一堆。

ex.en: Mozart was a famous composer from Austria.
ex.zh: 莫札特是來自奧地利的著名作曲家。

ex.en: The orchestra will play a piece by Mozart tonight.
ex.zh: 管弦樂團今晚將演奏莫札特的作品。

ex.en: Some parents play Mozart for their babies.
ex.zh: 有些父母會播放莫札特的音樂給寶寶聽。

ex.en: The floor of the old church is covered with a beautiful mosaic.
ex.zh: 這座古老教堂的地板鋪著一幅美麗的馬賽克。

ex.en: She made a mosaic from broken pieces of colored glass.
ex.zh: 她用破碎的彩色玻璃片拼出了一幅鑲嵌畫。

ex.en: Tourists stopped to admire the Roman mosaic in the museum.
ex.zh: 遊客停下來欣賞博物館裡的羅馬鑲嵌畫。

ex.en: They installed a mosaic tile wall in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 他們在廚房裝了一面馬賽克磁磚牆。

ex.en: The bathroom has a mosaic floor in blue and white.
ex.zh: 那間浴室有藍白相間的拼花地板。

ex.en: We stayed at a cheap motel beside the highway.
ex.zh: 我們住在公路旁一間便宜的汽車旅館。

ex.en: The motel has a parking space right outside each room.
ex.zh: 這間汽車旅館的每個房間外面都有停車位。

ex.en: There is mould on the bread, so don't eat it.
ex.zh: 麵包長黴了，不要吃。

ex.en: Damp walls can cause mould to grow in the bathroom.
ex.zh: 潮濕的牆壁會讓浴室長出黴菌。

ex.en: She poured the chocolate into a heart-shaped mould.
ex.zh: 她把巧克力倒進心形的模具。

ex.en: The factory uses a metal mould to make plastic toys.
ex.zh: 工廠用金屬模具製造塑膠玩具。

ex.en: The children moulded animals out of clay.
ex.zh: 孩子們用黏土捏出各種動物。

ex.en: Good teachers help mould a student's character.
ex.zh: 好老師會幫助塑造學生的品格。

ex.en: The monarch gave a speech to the nation on television.
ex.zh: 君主在電視上對全國人民發表談話。

ex.en: Britain has a monarch, but the government is led by a prime minister.
ex.zh: 英國有君主，但政府由首相領導。

ex.en: Britain is a monarchy with a king or queen as head of state.

ex.en: Every team needs a modicum of trust to work well.
ex.zh: 每個團隊都需要一點基本的信任才能運作良好。

ex.en: The project sank into a morass of delays.
ex.zh: 這個專案陷入一片延誤的泥淖。

ex.en: We tried to find our way through the morass of rules.
ex.zh: 我們試著在一大堆複雜的規定中找出方向。

ex.en: The hikers crossed a muddy morass with care.
ex.zh: 登山客小心地穿越一片泥濘的沼澤。

ex.en: Frogs lived in the morass beside the road.
ex.zh: 青蛙住在路旁的沼澤裡。

ex.en: The coach is good at motivating young players.
ex.zh: 教練很擅長激勵年輕球員。

ex.en: What is motivating you to learn a new language?
ex.zh: 是什麼促使你想學一種新語言？

ex.en: Winning the first match was a motivating experience for the team.
ex.zh: 贏下第一場比賽對球隊來說是振奮人心的經驗。

ex.en: A motivating speech can change how people feel about their work.
ex.zh: 一場鼓舞人心的演講可以改變人們對工作的感受。

ex.en: He read the report in a flat monotone.
ex.zh: 他用平板單調的語調念報告。

ex.en: The teacher's monotone put half the class to sleep.
ex.zh: 老師單調的聲音讓半個班級都睡著了。

ex.en: She chose a monotone painting for the office wall.
ex.zh: 她為辦公室牆面選了一幅單色調的畫。

ex.en: The singer's monotone voice bored the audience.
ex.zh: 歌手單調的嗓音讓聽眾覺得無聊。

ex.en: He sat in a corner, morose and silent.
ex.zh: 他坐在角落，悶悶不樂又沉默。

ex.en: She grew morose after losing her job.
ex.zh: 丟了工作後，她變得鬱鬱寡歡。

ex.en: The new office tower is a monstrosity that ruins the view.
ex.zh: 這棟新辦公大樓醜得像怪物，破壞了景觀。

ex.en: She hated the monstrosity of a sofa her aunt gave her.
ex.zh: 她很討厭阿姨送她的那張醜得誇張的沙發。

ex.en: One company tried to monopolise the whole market.
ex.zh: 有一家公司試圖壟斷整個市場。

ex.en: Please don't monopolise the conversation; let others speak.
ex.zh: 請不要獨佔談話，讓別人也說話。
